record.field: Lead PLC, DCS and SCADA migration projects for industrial manufacturing customers from system design through commissioning.

field.name: description
field.p: We are looking for an experienced Industrial Automation Engineer to lead system migration and new installation projects for our manufacturing customers. You will own the technical solution from concept design to site commissioning and hand-over.
This role reports to the Industrial Automation Manager and works closely with our project management office, procurement team and the customer's maintenance department.

ul.li: Design, program and commission PLC, DCS, HMI and SCADA systems (Schneider, Siemens, Mitsubishi, ABB).
Lead legacy system migration projects with minimal production downtime.
Prepare engineering documents: functional design specification, I/O list, cause and effect matrix, test procedure.
Perform factory acceptance test (FAT) and site acceptance test (SAT) with customers.
Supervise junior engineers and technicians during installation and commissioning.
Provide technical support and troubleshooting for preventive maintenance contracts.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or Control Engineering.
At least 7 years of hands-on experience in industrial automation and process control.
Strong programming skills on at least two PLC platforms (Modicon, S7, MELSEC, AC500).
Experience with SCADA software (AVEVA InTouch, Wonderware, WinCC, EcoStruxure).
Good command of English (reading technical documents is mandatory).
Able to travel to customer sites up-country and work on shutdown schedules.
Competitive salary with annual performance bonus.
Provident fund, group health insurance and annual health check-up.
Company vehicle or travelling allowance and site allowance.
Technical training and international certification sponsorship.
Clear career path to Project Manager / Engineering Manager.

record.field: Develop supervisory control, data acquisition and historian systems that give plant operators a complete, real-time view of production.

field.name: description
field.p: Join our software team to build centralized SCADA and reporting systems. You will design screen layouts, database structures and communication drivers that connect shop-floor equipment to management dashboards.

ul.li: Configure and program SCADA/HMI applications and historian databases.
Develop communication drivers for Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850 and database links.
Build real-time trend, alarm management and production reporting screens.
Integrate SCADA with ERP/MES systems through APIs and SQL.
Write technical documentation and user manuals, and train end users.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science or related field.
3 - 5 years of experience with SCADA / HMI platforms.
Working knowledge of SQL Server or PostgreSQL.
Basic scripting (VBScript, C#, Python or JavaScript) for custom features.
Understanding of industrial network architecture and cyber-security good practice.
Hybrid working arrangement and flexible start time.
Provident fund and group health insurance.
Access to paid online courses and certification exams.

record.field: Deliver GMP-compliant building automation, clean room control and computer system validation for life science customers.

field.name: description
field.p: Our Building Automation team is the market leader in Thailand's life science sector. You will implement BMS, EMS and clean room control systems that must satisfy strict GMP and Computer System Validation (CSV) requirements.

ul.li: Design and commission BMS, HVAC, clean room pressure cascade and environmental monitoring systems.
Prepare validation deliverables: URS, DQ, IQ, OQ, PQ, traceability matrix.
Configure controllers, sensors and graphics for pharmaceutical and food customers.
Support audit trails, access control and 21 CFR Part 11 / EU Annex 11 compliance.
Train customer engineering and quality teams.
Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Chemical Engineering.
3+ years of experience in building automation, HVAC control or GMP-validated systems.
Knowledge of GMP, GAMP 5 and Computer System Validation is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with BACnet, Modbus and Siemens / Schneider building controllers.
Detail-oriented with excellent documentation skills in English.
Performance bonus and GMP/CSV training program.
Provident fund and group health insurance.
Career path to Validation Lead / Project Manager.

record.field: Bangkok Head Office / Terminal sites nationwide
Service tank gauging, loading control and terminal management systems at oil, gas and chemical terminals.

field.name: description
field.p: Support our terminal automation customers with installation, calibration, troubleshooting and preventive maintenance of Automatic Tank Gauging (ATG), loading systems and Terminal Management Systems (TMS).

ul.li: Install, calibrate and maintain servo / radar tank gauges and tank side monitors.
Service loading controllers, metering skids, loading arms and overfill protection systems.
Perform preventive maintenance per contract schedule and issue service reports.
Diagnose field and network faults and coordinate corrective action with the factory.
Ensure all work complies with terminal safety permits and hot-work procedures.
Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation, Electrical or Mechatronics Engineering, or Vocational Certificate with strong field experience.
2+ years of field service experience in oil and gas, petrochemical or terminals.
Understanding of custody transfer, ATG and loading automation is an advantage.
Willing to travel and work at remote terminals, including night shifts during shutdowns.
Site allowance, overtime and per-diem for up-country assignments.
Provident fund, group health insurance and life insurance.
Factory-certified product training.

record.field: Grow our automation business by understanding customer needs, proposing the right solution and closing projects.

field.name: description
field.p: As an Automation Sales Engineer you will be the trusted technical advisor for our customers, translating their operational problems into a winning automation solution and quotation.

ul.li: Develop new customers and maintain relationships with existing accounts.
Conduct site surveys and gather technical requirements.
Prepare technical proposals, quotations and commercial documentation.
Coordinate with engineering and procurement teams on costing and lead time.
Follow up on payments and support project hand-over.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
2+ years of technical sales experience, preferably in industrial products or automation.
Good presentation, negotiation and communication skills in Thai and English.
Own a car and hold a valid driving licence.
Attractive commission scheme and quarterly incentive.
Car allowance, fuel card and mobile phone.
Provident fund and group health insurance.

record.field: Keep our automation projects on track and ISO-compliant through planning, documentation and coordination.

field.name: description
field.p: You will support the Project Management Office in planning, tracking and documenting automation projects so that every deliverable meets our ISO 9001 quality standard and customer deadline.

ul.li: Maintain project schedules, progress reports and minutes of meeting.
Control project documents and drawings under the ISO 9001 document control procedure.
Coordinate between customers, engineers, suppliers and the accounting team.
Prepare progress claims and supporting documents for billing.
Follow up purchase orders, delivery schedules and material receiving.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Engineering or related field.
0 - 2 years of experience; new graduates are welcome.
Excellent Microsoft Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Well organized, detail-oriented and able to work under pressure.
Structured onboarding and mentoring programme.
Provident fund and group health insurance.
Annual bonus and salary review.

record.field: Perform scheduled preventive maintenance, calibration and repair of automation equipment at customer plants.

field.name: description
field.p: Join our service team to keep our customers' automation systems running reliably. This is a hands-on role for a technical person who enjoys fieldwork and problem solving.

ul.li: Perform preventive maintenance on PLC, drives, sensors and control panels.
Calibrate and verify instruments according to customer procedures.
Repair and replace faulty components and report root cause.
Complete service checklists and reports in our ERP system.
Vocational Certificate or Higher Vocational Diploma in Electrical / Instrumentation / Mechatronics.
0 - 3 years of experience; willing to learn and be trained.
Able to read electrical drawings and use multimeter, loop calibrator and tools.
Willing to travel up-country and work occasional overtime.
Overtime pay, site allowance and travel expenses.
Group health insurance and annual health check-up.
On-the-job training with experienced engineers.

record.field: Bangkok Head Office / Engineering Center Lumlukka
A structured internship for engineering students to learn industrial, building and terminal automation from real projects.

field.name: description
field.p: Our internship programme gives students the opportunity to work alongside experienced engineers on live automation projects, from design and programming to site commissioning.
Interns are assigned a mentor and a real project deliverable, and receive a certificate of completion at the end of the programme.

ul.li: Assist engineers in programming, testing and documenting automation systems.
Prepare drawings, I/O lists and test records under supervision.
Join site visits and observe installation and commissioning activities.
Present a final project report to the engineering team.
3rd or 4th year student in Electrical, Instrumentation, Mechatronics or Computer Engineering.
Able to commit to a minimum of 2 months of continuous internship.
Basic knowledge of PLC programming is an advantage.
Positive attitude, punctual and eager to learn.
Monthly internship allowance and free lunch.
Mentorship by senior engineers.
Certificate of internship and priority consideration for full-time positions.
